title: Reflect wall of love
description: A centred badge, gradient heading and lead over two overlapping hairline rings that gently lean apart and back (5s) in a field of stars; under them two rows of 480px post cards (round avatar, name, handle, the post with @mentions in violet) that drift sideways on a very slow 200s loop, the second row half a cycle ahead, fading out at both screen edges. Avatars fade in on entering view.
notes: each row is rendered twice for a seamless loop; give each row enough posts to fill a wide screen (four is plenty)
avatars are 44px slots; empty, muted discs
CSS only; rows stand still under reduced motion
